first_comment_note: owner 19 Nov: every news post gets the page's own first comment, made automatically (no approval) - source paper + article link, news date, why the page shares news, corrections / objections by DM (post.py SOURCE_COMMENT)

reel_voice.note: Trichy 360: Valluvar (free edge-tts) reads every reel; Google voices are never used
reel_voice.ab_note: owner 26 Nov (Trichy views test): two free edge-tts Tamil voices, chosen per story by its headline (about half each) and saved with the post, so insights show which voice keeps viewers longer. [] or remove = Valluvar only
reel_voice.outro_text: Share this with your friends in Trichy. Follow Trichy Three Sixty.

prime_time.note: owner 21 Nov: NO best-time waiting - a news reel posts as soon as it is ready, any time from 05:00 to midnight (5 minutes apart). Nothing is posted on Instagram from 00:00 to 05:00 IST (quiet_ist), not even power cuts or stories; news ready at night posts from 05:00.

power_cut.note: owner 30 Oct: a power-cut reel reads EVERY area, so it may run to max_seconds (88 = 2 s under verify.py's 90 s check) with up to script_max_words; all other reels keep reel_max_seconds / reach.script_max_words. {} = normal limits

selection.note: owner 31 Oct: only news Instagram users watch is written - recipes / health and building tips / editorials, awareness days, awards, trophies, tenders, walkouts, tributes are not (research_free/collect.py low_interest). Power cuts and urgent news always. false = off

reel_punch_note: owner 27 Oct (change 1): every reel opens with a spoken punch line (yellow number + headline) while the big headline is on screen

reach.note: owner 29 Oct (views plan): each switch can be turned off here without code changes
reach.hashtag_note: owner 2 Nov: 5 tags, all from these fixed lists (never the writer's own tags): page + area + town (place_tags; a village maps to its town tag) + local topic (rain / power cut, else the page's news tag) + the Tamil place tag. A Rasipuram reel never carries a Namakkal page tag; no #TamilNews / #TamilNadu style tags
reach.share_line: 📤 திருச்சியில் இருக்கும் உங்கள் நண்பர்களுக்கு இந்த செய்தியை Share செய்யுங்கள்

free_images.note: owner 13 Nov (new pages): 2 pictures per reel - the news article's own photos first (vision-checked: this news, a real photo, not a file photo); one usable photo -> the second picture is a closer crop of it; none -> 2 AI pictures from the free services (FAL only when all fail)
free_images.views_test_note: owner 26 Nov (Trichy views test): 3 pictures per reel (was 2) - more visual change in a short reel; a missing third picture becomes a closer crop

writers.note: owner 30 Oct: free writing models in this order; a provider without its key is skipped; Claude (paid) only after all of them. Gemma 4 is ready but NOT in the order: 30 Oct test on a real story gave 503 (high demand) / 500 - add "gemma" here once writer-compare proves it. Cerebras removed 30 Oct: it now needs a card (only $5 trial credit, then paid). Sarvam taken out of the live order 30 Oct: writer-compare gave empty answers (finish_reason length) on 3 real stories - add "sarvam" back once writer-compare shows it writes

post_stories_note: owner 23 Nov: reels only - no Instagram or Facebook stories (the owner posts important ones by hand)
stories_urgent_only_note: owner 21 Nov (Instagram-safe): the story share only for power cuts / urgent news again, as Kovai and Chennai Minnal do - a story for every news took pages to 48/50 of Instagram's daily posts (blocks come near the limit) and doubled the Cloudinary downloads. false = every news gets its story
reel_style_note: owner 13 Nov 23:10: A = the Namakkal 360 design (same as Namakkal / Coimbatore) on this page; the premium look P below is switched off. Was: P = premium story panel (photo top 60 %, emerald panel with the headline and captions, champagne gold, ivory cards, serif headline, no black; district map + town pin, word-by-word headline, count-up numbers, one news-type layer, smooth loop, light sound effects). A = the earlier look.

posting.note: owner 21 Nov: 5 minutes between news posts on a page (19 Nov's 0 = every ready news at once: Trichy posted 5 reels in 3 minutes and Instagram blocked it). Urgent news still goes first.

reel_look_note: owner 20 Nov (final decision): ONE look on every page - the earlier, proven reel4 look (big hook, big captions, fact cards, FOLLOW end card) with '📅 date  📰 Source: paper' in the header and the 360 clock branding. "handoff" switches on the design team's look (reel/design360.py), kept in the code. (reel_design must stay "v4": it picks reel4.py.)
posted_email_note: owner 24 Nov: an e-mail for EVERY posted news again (each). owner 20 Nov: once the Promo Hub is set up (PROMO_URL), no e-mail per posted reel - the twice-a-day YouTube details e-mail per page lists them (Gmail's daily limit). "each" brings the per-reel e-mail back.
youtube_upload_note: owner 21 Nov: the day's best news reels go to the page's YouTube channel as Shorts - only when its YT_CLIENT_ID_/YT_CLIENT_SECRET_/YT_REFRESH_TOKEN_<PAGE> secrets exist. One Google Cloud project per page (about 6 uploads a day each). privacy stays private until Google approves the YouTube API audit, then set public.
ig_limits_note: owner 21 Nov (Trichy 20-21 Nov: the story catch-up tried the same stories every run - 400+ tries - and Instagram then refused every new post from 10:30 IST, Media Creation Limit 2207069): 'too many posts made' pauses the page ig_create_pause_hours, 'too many requests' ig_rate_pause_min, and a story that fails story_catchup_tries times is given up. Nothing is lost - the news posts after the pause.
ig_block_pause_note: owner 21 Nov: when Instagram says 'action is blocked' (2207051), the page's posting waits this many hours instead of trying every few minutes (that makes the block longer); its news is posted afterwards
story_reserve_note: owner 21 Nov: stories stop when 30 of Instagram's 50 posts a day are used - the last 20 are kept for NEWS (with a story for every news, stories filled the limit and Coimbatore's news waited at 48/50). A story that has to wait is posted later by the story catch-up.

views_test.note: owner 26 Nov: Trichy-only views test, posting count unchanged. (1) short reels: 35-75 words, at most 50 s (power cuts keep every area, up to 88 s); longer scripts already in the queue are shortened before the reel is made and the dropped sentences stay in the caption; (2) two voices A/B (reel_voice.ab_voices); (3) a Share line in the caption; (4) a shorter keyword line (place + topic first); (5) the spoken English end line asks viewers to share (reel_voice.outro_text); (6) insights also read skip rate and reposts and keep the voice / length of every reel. tools/views_test.py compares before and after. to go back to the old long reels: views_test.enabled false, reach.script_max_words 160, reel_max_seconds 88
views_test.styles_note: owner 26 Nov: 4 designs take turns (chosen by the headline, about a quarter each, independent of the voice): A = Namakkal 360 classic, B = TV broadcast red band, C = centred cinematic, P = premium story panel. The design is saved with each post. [] = classic only

post_error_note: owner 26 Nov (Trichy): a posting error on Instagram, Facebook or YouTube is noted at once (job log + poster/posting_errors.json) and that post is NOT tried again in the same run - the next try is after post_error_wait_min (10) minutes (Instagram's retry plan 10,10,10,15,15 then Hold; Facebook and YouTube 10 minutes). no_quick_retry false = the old quick repeats inside a run
